title: Meridian Systems rate card 2026
text: Day rates (USD): Engagement lead 1,600; Solution architect 1,450; Integration engineer 1,100; Data engineer 1,050; QA engineer 850; Trainer 800. Time-and-materials for change requests: blended 1,150 per day.

title: Margin and discount policy
text: Floor gross margin on fixed-price work is 32%. Discounts up to 10% may be offered when a comparable won deal supports it; discounts above 10% or below-floor pricing require the managing partner. Every deviation from rate card must cite the comparable deal.

title: Legal playbook
text: Unlimited liability: decline; standard position is liability capped at fees paid in the preceding 12 months, consequential loss excluded. Payment terms over 45 days: negotiate to 30 days, accept 45 with a 2% uplift. Termination for convenience under 30 days: negotiate to 30 days with payment for work in progress. IP assignment of pre-existing tools: decline; grant a perpetual licence instead. Service credits above 3% per incident or uncapped: negotiate a monthly cap of 15% of fees.

title: Proposal style guide
text: Answer each requirement in the client's numbering and words. Short paragraphs. Every claim about our experience cites a case study by id. Never say 'best in class', 'seamless' or 'world-class'. State assumptions explicitly. Price is always shown with what it includes and excludes.

title: Case study: Brightwater Distribution WMS integration (2025)
text: Integrated Cortex WMS with NetSuite and two carrier APIs for a 3-warehouse distributor. Near real-time sync under 3 minutes. Migrated 4 years of inventory data with automated reconciliation; zero unreconciled SKUs at go-live. Delivered in 22 weeks with 60 days hypercare. Team: 1 lead, 1 architect, 3 integration engineers, 1 data engineer, 1 QA.

title: Case study: Cedar Foods customer portal and tracking (2024)
text: Built a customer portal integration surfacing order status and carrier tracking from an ERP and three carriers, with SSO. 40,000 monthly users. Delivered in 14 weeks.

title: Proposal P-2025-07 · Brightwater Distribution · WON
text: WMS to NetSuite integration with two carriers and data migration. Fixed price USD 412,000; margin 36%; 12% discount on the data migration package justified by reusing our migration toolkit. Won against two competitors; client cited the reconciliation approach.

title: Proposal P-2025-11 · Kestrel Retail · LOST
text: WMS integration with four carriers and portal. Fixed price USD 540,000; margin 41%; no discount. Lost on price; the winning bid was reported at roughly 15% lower.

title: Proposal P-2026-02 · Oakline Wholesale · WON
text: ERP integration and monitoring dashboard. Fixed price USD 180,000; margin 34%; 8% discount on monitoring citing P-2025-07. Won.

title: Package-level estimates from past work (days by role)
text: ERP integration (NetSuite, 4 objects): architect 8, integration engineer 40, QA 10. Carrier API integration, per carrier: integration engineer 9, QA 3. Data migration, 4-5 years: data engineer 30, integration engineer 6, QA 8. Customer portal integration: integration engineer 22, QA 6. Monitoring dashboard: integration engineer 10, QA 2. Training, per 8 people: trainer 4. Hypercare 90 days: integration engineer 20. Engagement lead: 10% of engineering days. Returns workflow (optional): integration engineer 15, QA 4. Analytics layer (optional): data engineer 18, QA 4.
